summary: PASS with one new Low finding (F-DG0-015). The P0 specification is unchanged since round 28, and I re-checked it independently on candidate 84130c62 / 1e4c022. Extraction is verbatim-complete (1001/1001 paragraphs and cells, 49 tables). All 165 B blocks and 423 M blocks are dispositioned with 0 mapping problems (78 M blocks judged). T01–T16 columns and value lists, and all first-class deliverables, are preserved. SOURCE rows are grounded in the playbook. Provenance and #0078FF are honest. The operating-logic rules are specified with testable acceptance, and staging follows §21. D-045 correctly rejects an annotated-tag round source_commit: a mutation shows the test catches its removal, the real-history forge is rejected, and no genuine record regresses (27 present round source_commits, 120 fix_revisions and 103 heads are all commit objects). Pre-freeze passes 11/11. The D-045 row makes no business or provenance claim and correctly presents itself as completing D-044's class. Its heading misattributes a Low to the round-28 domain reviewer, which is F-DG0-015 (Low, non-mandatory). I concur with accepting it as an observation, pending the auditor. My own earlier findings F-DG0-013/014 were already CLOSED_VERIFIED.
